title: Comic Performance Of An Anti-Japanese Nature Staged In The Wellington Dance Hall, 287 Peking Road

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.    File No...........
Section 1, Special Branch 86libl, 7868
REPORT
Date April 20, 1937. 37

Subject......Comic Performance of an Anti-Japanese nature staged in the Wellington
Dance Hall, 287 Peking Road.
Made by...D.S.I. Shih Sau-chien    Forwarded by...Thoyne D S I

In accordance with the instruction of the D.C.
(Special Branch) on the attached report dated April 11, 1937
one Mr. Hsu Tsu-chuen (徐巨川), manager of the Wellington
Dance Hall, 287 Peking Road, was interviewed at the Headquarters
at 3 p.m. on April 19, 1937. When warned that shows having
political background were strictly prohibited in the Settlement,
Mr. Hsu stated that the intention of his dancing hall to stage
a comic performance on the night of April 10, was to stimulate
the interest of his patrons purely from a business point of
view, and he was unaware that the show in question was of an
anti-Japanese nature. He, however, gave assurance that in future
no show of a political nature would be allowed in his dancing
hall.

D.S.I.

特务科第1股 86libl, 7868
报告
日期：1937年4月20日。 37

事由......在北京路287号惠令登舞厅上演的具有反日性质的滑稽表演。
呈报人...警探长施守坚 (Shih Sau-chien)    转呈人...托恩 (Thoyne) 警探长

遵照特务科副总监在附后之1937年4月11日报告上的指示，
北京路287号惠令登舞厅经理徐巨川先生于1937年4月19日下午3时在总局接受问询。当被告知在租界内严禁上演具有政治背景的节目时，徐先生表示，其舞厅于4月10日晚安排滑稽表演的目的，纯粹是从商业角度出发以激发顾客的兴趣，他并未意识到该表演具有反日性质。然而，他保证今后绝不允许在其舞厅内上演任何具有政治性质的节目。

警探长

Section 1, Special Branch
REPORT
File No. 7868

Date April 11, 19 37.

Subject Comic Performance of an Anti-Japanese nature staged in the Wellington
Dance Hall, 287 Peking Road.

Made by D.S.I. Shih Ssu-chien Forwarded by J. Boyne D.S.I.

On April 10, 1937 the following advertisement
was inserted in a local newspaper, entitled "Sin Wan Pao" :-
"The Wellington Dance Hall, Peking Road
"near Honan Road, has engaged two Chinese
"comedians named Tong Siao-fee (唐笑飛)
"and Woo Gee Gee (胡琪琪) to act and
"sing a comic song entitled "Great
"Victory at Pailingmiao. Their acts and
"performances are so amusing that patrons
"will hold their sides with laughter".

A detective attached to this section was detailed
to keep observation during the performance. According to the
detective's report, the performance, which commenced at about
10 p.m. April 10, 1937 and ended some 20 minutes later, depicted
the victory won by the Chinese army over Japanese soldiers and
bandits, adding that several thousands of Japanese soldiers were
killed in less than two hours' time during the Pailingmiao
engagement.

The staging of this performance was only for one
night, April 10 and will not be repeated to-night, April 11, 1937.

报告
档案编号 7868
13 " 37
日期：1937年4月11日。

事由：在北京路287号惠令登舞厅上演的具有反日性质的滑稽表演。

呈报人：警探长施思坚 (Shih Ssu-chien) 转呈人：J. Boyne 警探长

1937年4月10日，一家名为《新闻报》(Sin Wan Pao) 的本地报纸刊登了如下广告：-
“位于河南路附近的北京路‘惠令登舞厅’
“已聘请两名中国滑稽演员，
“名为唐笑飛 (Tong Siao-fee)
“和胡琪琪 (Woo Gee Gee)，表演并
“演唱一首题为《百灵庙大捷》
“的滑稽歌曲。他们的动作和
“表演极其滑稽，定会让顾客捧腹大笑”。

本科指派一名侦探在表演期间进行监视。根据该侦探的报告，这场于1937年4月10日晚10时许开始、约20分钟后结束的表演，描绘了中国军队战胜日本士兵和匪徒的情景，并称在百灵庙战役中，日军在不到两小时内就有数千人被杀。

该表演仅演出一晚，即4月10日，今晚（1937年4月11日）不再重演。

cl.
特务科副总监。
